title: Adobe projection: 2026 online holiday sales to reach $275.1 billion

facts.fact: Adobe projects online sales in the last two months of 2026 (its holiday season, Nov. 1 through Dec. 31) to reach $275.1 billion.
facts.quote: projecting that online sales in the last two months of the year will reach $275.1 billion

facts.fact: Adobe's holiday forecast is based on more than 1 trillion visits to U.S. retail sites, 100 million SKUs and 18 product categories.
facts.quote: based its forecast on more than 1 trillion visits to U.S. retail sites, 100 million SKUs and 18 product categories

facts.fact: Adobe projects 2026 holiday online sales to increase 6.7% year over year.
facts.quote: online holiday-season sales in 2026 would increase 6.7% year over year

facts.fact: Adobe projects Electronics to be the top holiday category with $63.3 billion in 2026 online sales, up 5.9% year over year.
facts.quote: Electronics ($63.3 billion, which would mark a 5.9% year-over-year increase)

facts.fact: Adobe projects Apparel holiday online sales of $51.3 billion in 2026, up 4.7% year over year.
facts.quote: Apparel ($51.3 billion, up 4.7%)

facts.fact: Adobe projects Furniture holiday online sales of $33.4 billion in 2026, up 7.3% year over year.
facts.quote: Furniture ($33.4 billion, up 7.3%)

facts.fact: Adobe projects Grocery holiday online sales of $26.1 billion in 2026, up 10.3% year over year.
facts.quote: Grocery ($26.1 billion, up 10.3%)

facts.fact: Adobe projects Toys holiday online sales of $9.6 billion in 2026, up 9.6% year over year.
facts.quote: Toys ($9.6 billion, up 9.6%)

facts.fact: Adobe projects Cosmetics holiday online sales of $9.2 billion in 2026, up 9.5% year over year.
facts.quote: Cosmetics ($9.2 billion, up 9.5%)

facts.fact: Adobe projects Cyber Monday 2026 online sales in the U.S. to reach $15.1 billion, 6.2% year-over-year growth.
facts.quote: Its projection has Cyber Monday generating $15.1 billion online in the U.S., which would mark 6.2% year-over-year growth.

facts.fact: Adobe reported that consumers spent $14.25 billion in ecommerce sales on Cyber Monday 2025.
facts.quote: In total, consumers spent $14.25 billion in ecommerce sales on Cyber Monday 2025, according to Adobe.

facts.fact: Adobe projects Black Friday 2026 online sales of $12.9 billion, up 9.2% year over year.
facts.quote: It anticipates Black Friday sales in 2026 reaching $12.9 billion, increasing 9.2% year over year.

facts.fact: Adobe projects Thanksgiving Day 2026 ecommerce sales of $6.9 billion, up 8.5%.
facts.quote: Adobe anticipates Thanksgiving Day ecommerce sales to reach $6.9 billion in 2026. That would mark 8.5% growth

facts.fact: Adobe projects 63% of Thanksgiving Day 2026 online sales to come from mobile devices, versus 61.6% in 2025.
facts.quote: a day that Adobe projects 63% of all online sales to come from mobile devices. 61.6% of all Thanksgiving Day ecommerce sales came from mobile devices in 2025

facts.fact: Adobe projects 57.4% of total 2026 holiday-season online sales to come from mobile devices, up from 56.4% the year before.
facts.quote: Adobe projects 57.4% of online sales to come from mobile devices. That would mark an increase from 56.4% the year before.

facts.fact: Adobe projects buy now, pay later (BNPL) could generate $21.3 billion in 2026 holiday-season ecommerce sales, up 6.6%.
facts.quote: Buy now, pay later (BNPL) could generate $21.3 billion in holiday-season ecommerce sales, Adobe said, up 6.6%.

facts.fact: Adobe projects BNPL usage could account for $1.09 billion on Cyber Monday 2026, and $807 million on Black Friday 2026.
facts.quote: on Cyber Monday alone, BNPL usage could account for $1.09 billion. Adobe also projects BNPL spending for online orders to reach $807 million on Black Friday 2026.

facts.fact: Adobe projects AI traffic to U.S. retail sites to increase 130% year over year during the 2026 holiday season.
facts.quote: In the 2026 holiday shopping season, Adobe projects AI traffic to U.S. retail sites to increase 130% year over year.

facts.fact: In an Adobe survey of 5,000 online shoppers, 77% of respondents who have used AI for online shopping reported feeling more confident in their purchase.
facts.quote: 77% of respondents who have used AI for online shopping reported feeling more confident in their purchase.

facts.fact: In the same Adobe survey of 5,000 online shoppers, 69% of respondents said they were less likely to return an item they bought.
facts.quote: 69% of respondents said they were less likely to return an item they bought.

facts.fact: Adobe anticipates U.S. consumers will spend $95.8 billion online during October 2026, 8% more than October 2025.
facts.quote: U.S. consumers will spend $95.8 billion online during October 2026. That would be 8% more than the same month in 2025.

facts.fact: Adobe anticipates U.S. consumers spending $10 billion online during the 48-hour Amazon Prime Day event on Oct. 6 and 7, 2026.
facts.quote: Adobe anticipates U.S. consumers spending $10 billion online during the 48-hour Amazon Prime Day event period on Oct. 6 and 7.
